name: unripe
summary: Fail the build when a locked dependency is younger than you trust. One check for npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, Deno, PyPI, Cargo, Go, Composer, RubyGems, NuGet, Gradle, Dart, CocoaPods, Swift, Terraform, Conan, R renv.lock, Elixir mix.lock, Nix flake.lock, Bazel and vcpkg lockfiles, GitHub Actions, and an MCP server for AI agents.
author: Tex
